blocks.tamil_translation: (اَللّهُمَّ مَنْ وَلِيَ مِنْ أَمْرِ أُمَّتِي شَيْئاً فَشَقَّ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَاشْقُقْ عَلَيْهِ وَمَنْ وَلِيَ مِنْ أَمْرِ أُمَّتِي شَيْئاً فَرَفَقَ بِهِمْ، فَارْفُقْ بِهِ) O Allah, if anyone takes charge of any one of the affairs (worldly or religious) of my Ummah and then puts the people into hardship, You too put him into hardship! And whoever takes charge of the affairs of my Ummah and deals gently with the people, You too deal gently with that person,” Hazrat Aishah (RA) narrates that she heard Rasulullah ﷺ make this du'a in this house of hers.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ وَكَثِيرِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ وَعَمْرِو بْنِ اْلاَسْوَدِ وَالْمِقْدَامِ بْنِ مَعْدِيكَرِبَ وَأَبِيْ أُمَامَةَ ﵃ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ اْلاَمِيرَ إِذَا ابْتَغَي الرِّيبَةَ فِي النَّاسِ أَفْسَدَهُمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب في التجسس، رقم:٤٨٨٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “When the amir seeks out suspicion and doubtful matters among the people, he corrupts the people,” Hazrat Jubair ibn Nufair, Hazrat Kathir ibn Murrah, Hazrat Amr ibn Aswad, Hazrat Miqdam ibn Ma'dikarib and Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrate that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- If the amir does not hold a good opinion of the people, but keeps searching for their faults and holds bad thoughts about them, he himself becomes the cause of confusion and division arising among the people. Therefore, the meaning of this hadith is that the amir should conceal their faults and hold a good opinion of them.
(Badhl-ul-Majhud)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أُمِّ الْحُصَيْنِ ﵂ قَالَتْ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِنْ أُمِّرَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَبْدٌ مُجَدَّعٌ أَسْوَدُ يَقُودُكُمْ بِكِتَابِ اللهِ فَاسْمَعُوا لَهُ وَأَطِيعُوا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب وجوب طاعة الامراء ...، رقم:٤٧٦٢
